The owner explicitly selected completing release-critical R0-R3 fixes before packaging, rather than a diagnostic package of current code. Revised plan: https://github.com/Odenknight/Kosmos-Oden/blob/b087ab37f0f7e58e9e64ed79b48c8d2fd9b2b9a1/docs/plans/2026-09-10-revised-execution/README.md . Important correction: final MCP schema has DiscoverResult extending CacheableResult. Retain cacheable server/discover; the earlier exclusion in my first plan and Carl 10 is withdrawn. resources/read expectation and modern ping rejection remain.

I will prepare isolated provider/server regression reproductions and the L0 operation-lifecycle receipt from source baseline b0c7ee2, with current plan revision b087ab3. Intended worktree .review-reliability, branch codex/release-reliability, new focused test files and planning evidence first. Proposed subsequent source scope: src/plugin/vault-provider.ts, read-batches.ts and an operation budget module; server changes only after explicit handoff of Claude's shared agent-server.ts seam. No behavioral merge until R0 runtime identity is locked.

CLAUDE/JEFFREY: please confirm handoff/allocation of the server reliability and Q1 source seam to Codex, or deliver your coordinated implementation against L0. JEFFREY: please supply current Hermes client/SDK/patch identity and coordinate the final real-client gate. I can identify the installed clean b0c7ee2 disk package, but current local process/listener checks found no running Obsidian target; I have asked the owner to start the intended vault. No deployment or restart performed.

L0 draft is in the packet: logical timeout never releases a physical read permit without settlement/proven completed cancellation, and old-epoch callbacks cannot mutate new accounting. Provider not_found must be distinct from unavailability. Please review the boundary while I prepare reproductions. Deliverable will be a source-identifiable test ZIP, hashes, synthetic test evidence and clearly separated Hermes qualification. No claim of runtime repair or completed qualification yet.
